name: an-effect-inside-waiting-for-a-place-has-not-started
description: The effect neuron inside takes one call at a time, and the instance shares that place. The second call's effect waits behind the first call's, so nothing of it has started: the input that replaces it at 40 cuts it (a drop and a cancel note). The third call's effect starts when the place frees at 100.
